 def append_pack_entry(buffer, arcname: str, content: bytes) -> None:

-    unchanged pack is byte-identical to a full rebuild of the same files.
+    """Append one entry to a tar stream that is still open in ``w|`` mode.
+
+    Used when an existing pack is written back: the live stream collects the
+    archive and the one trailing zero-record terminator that ``w|`` writes only
+    on close, so a pack rebuilt this way is byte-identical to the archive the
+    same members would produce through ``build_pack_tar``.
     """
-    with tarfile.open(fileobj=buffer, mode="w|", format=tarfile.GNU_FORMAT) as archive:

 def _tar_info(arcname: str, size: int) -> tarfile.TarInfo:
@@ -579,10 +579,12 @@
     size: int

     files_total: int
-    # ``(arcname, size, content)``; the content is kept so members that are
-    # unchanged on a rewrite can be archived from the old pack without a second
-    # source read, and so ``JobRunner`` can hash each member once.
+    # ``(arcname, size, content)``; the content is kept so that rewriting a
+    # pack can archive its members straight from the loaded archive instead of
+    # re-reading the whole source. Their sha256 is precomputed once at load, so
+    # unchanged detection never hashes a decoded member again.
     members: list = field(default_factory=list)

@@ -590,11 +592,12 @@

+
+    Other files are not packs and are ignored. Pack ids are taken from the

+    over the pack at the same repack position, which keeps the layout stable
